epg.description: Ambika is the eldest daughter-in-law of the wealthy Rajgaur family. She adopts a girl, Kesar, when the youngest daughter-in-law, Hetal, demands a separation in the family and says that a daughter-in-law is never treated like a daughter. So, Ambika vows to prove her wrong. She vows to raise Kesar as her daughter-in-law, who will eventually marry her son Suraj.
